title: IPTV Troubleshooting: Buffering, EPG & Playlist Fixes
description: Step-by-step fixes for common IPTV problems: buffering and freezing, EPG not showing, playlists that will not load, audio sync and more.
intro: Most IPTV problems come down to a handful of causes: network throughput, player buffer settings, malformed playlists or EPG mismatches. Each guide here walks through a diagnosis order so you fix the real cause instead of guessing.

faq.question: Why does IPTV buffer even on fast broadband?
faq.answer: Buffering is rarely about raw download speed. Wi-Fi interference, an undersized player buffer, DNS or ISP routing, and the source server itself are more common causes. Our buffering guide covers how to isolate each one.
